description: Verify pregnancy gestation eligibility (12+ weeks) and optional slot availability, then generate a direct pre-selected booking URL on bumptobabysa.co.za where the parent confirms their slot (pay on arrival by card or cash). When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'prepare_booking_link' on Bump to Baby Store (bumptobabysa.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_studio_info' or 'get_scan_packages_and_pricing' or 'get_gestational_guide' for their respective operations). Parameters: package_slug (required), date (optional), time (optional), gestation_weeks (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

date.description: Optional preferred appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format to pre-verify availability.

gestation_weeks.description: Optional gestational age in weeks (must be 12 or higher; 14+ weeks recommended for gender).

package_slug.description: Desired scan package code: "4d" (4D/5D HD-Live Scan R850), "gender" (Gender Reveal Scan R600), or "2d" (2D Reassurance Scan R500). [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

time.description: Optional preferred start time in 24-hour HH:MM format (e.g. "10:00").

name: prepare_booking_link
title: Prepare Booking Link
